meta.name: story-deslop
meta.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清除网文中的AI腔，让文字读起来像人写的
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用AI写网文，却不想让读者看出来
copy.tagline_en: Remove AI-sounding phrasing from web novels and make the text read naturally.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI to write web novels but want the prose to feel genuinely human.

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求“去AI味”或检测AI味时，Claude 会扫描网文，标记禁用词、句式、节奏等AI痕迹，按轻/中/重度分级，再逐项改写为自然口语、动作描写，并输出检测与润色报告。只改“怎么说”，不动剧情和人物。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /story-deslop、或说出“去AI味”“这篇太AI了”“网文去AI味”等关键词，或要求在写作中检测或润色文本时触发。

say.text: 这段太AI了，帮我改得自然点。
say.note: Claude 会扫描并逐句改写这段文字。

say.text: 检查一下这篇有没有AI味。
say.note: 只检测不改写，输出AI味检测报告。

say.text: 把这份网文去AI味，别动剧情。
say.note: 按保留创作意图原则改写，只改表达。

howto.what_en: When asked to remove AI flavor, Claude scans web novel text, flags AI-like patterns (banned words, sentence patterns, rhythm), grades severity, then rewrites into natural colloquial phrasing and action lines, outputting detection and polish reports. It changes how things are said, not the plot.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says keywords like 'remove AI flavor', 'this reads too AI', or uses /story-deslop, requesting check or polish of text.

say_en.text: This reads too AI; make it sound more natural.
say_en.note: Claude will scan and rewrite this passage.

say_en.text: Check this piece for AI traces.
say_en.note: Detection only; outputs an AI-flavor report.

say_en.text: De-AI this web novel, but keep the plot.
say_en.note: Rewrites wording while preserving narrative intent.
